Luminance is roughly proportional to 0.2*(R^2.4)+0.6*(G^2.4), suggesting something like lightdark<-function (color) { rgb <- col2rgb(color)/255 L <- c(0.2, 0.6, 0) %*% rgb ifelse(L >= 0.2, "#000060", "#FFFFA0") } This uses a pale yellow for dark backgrounds and a dark blue for light backgrounds, and it seems to work reasonably well. -thomas ______________________________________________ R-help@stat.math.
